verdict.rationale: Pendo's Data Sync is a first-party export of Pendo data to Snowflake or to cloud storage (S3, Azure, Google Cloud), so a real bulk-export path exists. The evidence never names the file formats, never confirms that every data type is included, and never describes how to close an account and leave. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/JSON), confirmation that all data types are exportable, documented account exit or offboarding, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Send your data direct to Snowflake, no engineering required—or configure your export for cloud storage.
Centralize insights from Pendo directly into Snowflake, S3, Azure, or Google Cloud for an instant, complete picture of your customer journey
